title: 消色差透鏡設計~Achromatic lens design
focus: 三片式複消色差、熱離焦、膠合與空氣間隔取捨、定心膠合工序、感測器匹配 MTF、波前與鬼影驗收~Three-glass apochromats, thermal defocus, cemented versus air-spaced trade-offs, centring and cementing, sensor-matched MTF, wavefront and ghost acceptance
summary: 延伸既有的色散、光焦度分配與公差課程，以 f = 100 mm、f/4 的雙合透鏡搭配 3.45 µm 像素感測器為主線，深入三片式複消色差的 P_gF 解、光熱係數與鏡筒熱離焦、膠合與空氣間隔的取捨、生產定心與膠合、依 Nyquist 頻率訂定的 MTF 判準、雙程干涉波前換算、鬼影路徑分析，以及含保護帶的量產驗收。~Extending the existing lessons on dispersion, power allocation and tolerances, this part follows an f = 100 mm, f/4 doublet on a 3.45 µm-pixel sensor through the P_gF solution for three-glass apochromats, opto-thermal coefficients and barrel defocus, cemented versus air-spaced trade-offs, production centring and cementing, Nyquist-based MTF criteria, double-pass interferometric wavefront conversion, ghost-path analysis and guard-banded production acceptance.

units.anchor: 三片式複消色差組~Three-glass apochromatic group
units.title: 部分色散與三片式複消色差解~Partial dispersion and the three-glass apochromatic solution
units.mechanism: 兩片玻璃的消色差只能讓 C 與 F 線共焦；一般玻璃的相對部分色散落在正常線 P_gF ≈ 0.6438 − 0.001682·ν_d 上，其他波長仍各自聚焦，留下二級光譜。要讓第三個波長也共焦，需同時滿足三個條件：總光焦度 Σφᵢ = φ、一級色差 Σφᵢ/νᵢ = 0、二級色差 Σφᵢ·Pᵢ/νᵢ = 0。三種玻璃在 (1/ν, P) 平面上必須圍成三角形，三角形面積越小，各片光焦度越大；正常線之外的異常色散玻璃（如 N-FK51A 的 ΔP_gF = +0.034、N-KZFS4 的 −0.010）可以把三角形撐開。三片式的代價是單片光焦度變大、曲率變陡，高階像差與定心敏感度隨之上升。~A two-glass achromat can only bring the C and F lines to a common focus; ordinary glasses have relative partial dispersions on the normal line P_gF ≈ 0.6438 − 0.001682·ν_d, so other wavelengths still focus elsewhere and leave the secondary spectrum. Bringing a third wavelength to the same focus requires three conditions at once: total power Σφᵢ = φ, zero primary colour Σφᵢ/νᵢ = 0 and zero secondary colour Σφᵢ·Pᵢ/νᵢ = 0. The three glasses must form a triangle in the (1/ν, P) plane, and the smaller its area the larger the individual element powers; anomalous-dispersion glasses off the normal line, such as N-FK51A with ΔP_gF = +0.034 and N-KZFS4 with −0.010, open the triangle up. The price of a triplet is larger element powers and steeper curves, so higher-order aberrations and centring sensitivity grow.
units.model: 由 Sellmeier 係數算得 N-FK51A（ν = 84.47、P = 0.5359）、N-KZFS4（44.49、0.5590）、N-SF5（32.25、0.5984）。f = 100 mm 解三式：φ₁ = 2.576φ（f₁ = 38.8 mm）、φ₂ = −2.153φ（f₂ = −46.4 mm）、φ₃ = 0.577φ（f₃ = 173.3 mm）；以實際折射率逐線計算，C、F、g 焦點都落在 d 焦點 0.15 µm 以內。對照 N-BK7/F2 雙合：C、F 在 d 後 50 µm、g 在 223 µm；但三片式 Σ|φᵢ| = 5.31φ，雙合只有 3.62φ。~From Sellmeier coefficients: N-FK51A (ν = 84.47, P = 0.5359), N-KZFS4 (44.49, 0.5590) and N-SF5 (32.25, 0.5984). Solving the three equations for f = 100 mm gives φ₁ = 2.576φ (f₁ = 38.8 mm), φ₂ = −2.153φ (f₂ = −46.4 mm) and φ₃ = 0.577φ (f₃ = 173.3 mm); tracing with real indices line by line puts the C, F and g foci within 0.15 µm of the d focus. For comparison an N-BK7/F2 doublet leaves C and F 50 µm behind d and g at 223 µm, but the triplet carries Σ|φᵢ| = 5.31φ against 3.62φ for the doublet.
units.verify: 以實際熔煉批的熔次資料（n_d、ν_d、P_gF）取代型錄值重新解光焦度；組裝後用單色儀或窄帶濾光片在 C、d、F、g 各波長量軸向最佳焦點，確認焦點散佈小於景深，並與模型的 0.15 µm 等級殘差比較；同時量各片偏心，因為大光焦度讓同樣的偏心產生更大的彗差。~Re-solve the powers with melt-sheet data (n_d, ν_d, P_gF) from the actual glass lots instead of catalogue values; after assembly measure the axial best focus at C, d, F and g with a monochromator or narrow-band filters, confirm the spread is smaller than the depth of focus and compare with the modelled 0.15 µm-level residual; measure element decentration as well, because large powers turn the same decentre into more coma.
units.failure: FK51A 類氟磷冠玻璃硬度低、膨脹係數大、耐候性差，拋光或膠合時容易出現裂紋與表面污斑；若沿用型錄 P_gF 而不看熔次資料，三色共焦點偏移，實際殘餘色差可能比設計大一個數量級，而大光焦度也讓軸上彗差對定心誤差極為敏感。~Fluorophosphate crowns of the FK51A type are soft, high-expansion and weather poorly, so they crack or stain during polishing or cementing; using catalogue P_gF instead of melt data shifts the three-colour focus so the real residual colour can be an order of magnitude above design, and the large powers make on-axis coma extremely sensitive to centring error.
units.misconception: 只要兩片玻璃的阿貝數差夠大，就能完全消除二級光譜。~A large enough Abbe-number difference between two glasses eliminates the secondary spectrum.

units.anchor: 熱光係數與鏡筒膨脹~Thermo-optic coefficient and barrel expansion
units.title: 熱離焦與光熱係數~Thermal defocus and the opto-thermal coefficient
units.mechanism: 溫度同時改變折射率（dn/dT）與鏡片尺寸（膨脹係數 α），薄透鏡在空氣中的焦距變化率為 (1/f)·df/dT = α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)，稱為光熱係數。型錄的 dn/dT 是相對於空氣的值，SCHOTT 另以 G = α(n − 1) + dn/dT 表示玻璃的熱光常數。雙合透鏡的光熱係數按各片光焦度加權相加；同時鏡片到感測器之間的鏡筒或隔圈以 α_h·L 伸長。無熱化設計要讓像面移動與機構伸長相等，即 γ·f ≈ α_h·L，這對戶外相機、車載與太空光學尤其關鍵。~Temperature changes both the refractive index (dn/dT) and the lens dimensions (expansion coefficient α), and for a thin lens in air the focal-length change rate is (1/f)·df/dT = α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1), the opto-thermal coefficient. Catalogue dn/dT values are relative to air, and SCHOTT also expresses the thermo-optical constant as G = α(n − 1) + dn/dT. A doublet's opto-thermal coefficient is the power-weighted sum of its elements, while the barrel or spacer between lens and sensor grows by α_h·L. Athermal design makes image-plane motion equal mount growth, γ·f ≈ α_h·L, which is critical for outdoor, automotive and space cameras.
units.model: N-BK7：α = 7.1 ppm/K、相對 dn/dT = 3.0 ppm/K（e 線）、n_e − 1 = 0.5187，γ = 7.1 − 5.78 = 1.32 ppm/K；F2：8.2 − 4.4/0.6241 = 1.15 ppm/K。雙合權重 2.308 與 −1.308，γ = 2.308 × 1.32 − 1.308 × 1.15 ≈ 1.53 ppm/K。f = 100 mm、ΔT = 40 K：焦距伸長 6.1 µm；鋁鏡筒 100 mm × 23.6 ppm/K × 40 K = 94.4 µm，失配 88 µm，是 f/4 景深 ±2λN² = ±17.6 µm 的 5 倍；改用 Invar（1.2 ppm/K）隔圈伸長 4.8 µm，殘差僅 1.3 µm。~N-BK7: α = 7.1 ppm/K, relative dn/dT = 3.0 ppm/K (e-line), n_e − 1 = 0.5187, so γ = 7.1 − 5.78 = 1.32 ppm/K; F2: 8.2 − 4.4/0.6241 = 1.15 ppm/K. With doublet weights 2.308 and −1.308, γ = 2.308 × 1.32 − 1.308 × 1.15 ≈ 1.53 ppm/K. For f = 100 mm and ΔT = 40 K the focal length grows 6.1 µm, while an aluminium barrel grows 100 mm × 23.6 ppm/K × 40 K = 94.4 µm, a mismatch of 88 µm, five times the f/4 depth of focus ±2λN² = ±17.6 µm; an Invar spacer (1.2 ppm/K) grows 4.8 µm, leaving only 1.3 µm.
units.verify: 把鏡頭與感測器裝在溫控箱中，於 −20、20、60 °C 各浸泡到熱平衡後量穿焦 MTF 求最佳焦距，算出 Δz/ΔT 與模型比較；另以千分錶或干涉測長單獨量鏡筒伸長，分離光學項與機構項；再做快速升溫測試，觀察徑向溫度梯度造成的暫態離焦與球差。~Mount lens and sensor in a thermal chamber, soak to equilibrium at −20, 20 and 60 °C, measure through-focus MTF to find best focus and compare the resulting Δz/ΔT with the model; measure barrel growth separately with a dial gauge or interferometric length measurement to separate optical and mechanical terms; then run a fast ramp to observe transient defocus and spherical aberration from radial temperature gradients.
units.failure: 鋁鏡筒在低溫收縮壓迫玻璃，產生應力雙折射與像散，嚴重時崩邊或破裂；黏著劑在高溫蠕變，鏡片位置不回復；溫度快速變化時徑向梯度造成暫態離焦，影像在數分鐘內忽清忽糊。~An aluminium barrel shrinking at low temperature squeezes the glass, causing stress birefringence and astigmatism and in severe cases edge chipping or fracture; adhesive creeps at high temperature so the lens does not return to position; rapid temperature change creates radial gradients and transient defocus, so the image drifts in and out of focus for minutes.
units.misconception: 玻璃的熱膨脹很小，所以溫度變化不會讓焦點移動。~Glass expands so little that temperature changes cannot move the focus.

units.anchor: 膠合界面與空氣間隔~Cemented interface and air gap
units.title: 膠合與空氣間隔雙合透鏡的取捨~Cemented versus air-spaced doublet trade-offs
units.mechanism: 膠合雙合透鏡兩片內曲率相同，只有三個面，界面以折射率接近的膠填滿，反射極低、對位穩固、鬼影路徑少；但只有三個曲率，用來定光焦度、消色差與彎曲修正球差後就沒有自由度處理大孔徑下的色球差與彗差。膠層還要承受兩種玻璃膨脹係數差造成的剪應變，限制了口徑與玻璃組合，紫外與高功率雷射下膠也會吸收老化。空氣間隔版有四個曲率加一個間距，可在兩個波長同時修正球差並控制彗差，適合更快的 f 數與更大口徑，代價是間距與偏心公差、多兩個需鍍膜的空氣界面，以及間距誤差直接改變焦距。~A cemented doublet has equal inner radii and only three surfaces; the interface is filled with index-matched cement, so reflection is very low, alignment is robust and there are few ghost paths. But three curvatures are used up setting power, correcting colour and bending for spherical aberration, leaving no freedom for spherochromatism and coma at large aperture. The cement layer must also absorb the shear strain from the two glasses' expansion mismatch, which limits diameter and glass pairs, and cement absorbs and ages under UV and high-power lasers. An air-spaced version has four curvatures plus a gap, so it can correct spherical aberration at two wavelengths and control coma, suiting faster f-numbers and larger apertures, at the cost of spacing and decentre tolerances, two more air–glass surfaces to coat, and a gap error that changes focal length directly.
units.model: 間距敏感度：φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂，∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 時 f₁ = 43.3 mm、f₂ = −76.4 mm，−φ₁φ₂ = 3.02×10⁻⁴ mm⁻²，Δf = −f²·Δφ ≈ −3.02·Δd，隔圈差 10 µm 焦距就變 −30 µm。膠合界面反射：BK7/膠 (n = 1.56) 為 2.0×10⁻⁴、膠/F2 為 3.6×10⁻⁴，未鍍膜空氣界面約 4.3%。Ø50 mm 在 ΔT = 40 K 時邊緣錯位：BK7/F2（Δα = 1.1 ppm/K）1.1 µm，15 µm 膠層剪應變 0.07；CaF₂（18.9 ppm/K）配約 8 ppm/K 的火石 10.9 µm，剪應變 0.73。~Gap sensitivity: φ = φ₁ + φ₂ − dφ₁φ₂, so ∂φ/∂d = −φ₁φ₂. For N-BK7/F2 at f = 100 mm, f₁ = 43.3 mm and f₂ = −76.4 mm give −φ₁φ₂ = 3.02×10⁻⁴ mm⁻² and Δf = −f²·Δφ ≈ −3.02·Δd, so a 10 µm spacer error moves focal length by −30 µm. Cement-interface reflectance: BK7 to cement (n = 1.56) 2.0×10⁻⁴ and cement to F2 3.6×10⁻⁴, against about 4.3% for an uncoated air surface. Edge mismatch for Ø50 mm over ΔT = 40 K: BK7/F2 (Δα = 1.1 ppm/K) 1.1 µm, a 0.07 shear strain in a 15 µm cement layer; CaF₂ (18.9 ppm/K) against a flint near 8 ppm/K gives 10.9 µm and 0.73.
units.verify: 空氣間隔版在組裝時以焦距量測台量有效焦距對隔圈厚度的變化，驗證 −3 µm/µm 的敏感度；以干涉儀或波前感測器在兩個波長量球差，確認色球差被修正；膠合版做 −40 到 +70 °C 熱循環，之後以斜射光檢查邊緣是否出現牛頓環或銀白脫膠，並以偏光儀檢查應力雙折射。~For the air-spaced version measure effective focal length against spacer thickness on a focal-length bench during assembly to confirm the −3 µm/µm sensitivity, and measure spherical aberration at two wavelengths with an interferometer or wavefront sensor to confirm spherochromatism is corrected; cycle the cemented version from −40 to +70 °C, then inspect the edge under oblique light for Newton rings or silvery delamination and check stress birefringence with a polariscope.
units.failure: 膨脹係數差大的膠合組在低溫脫膠，邊緣出現牛頓環與銀白反光，波前與穿透率同時劣化；空氣間隔版的隔圈鬆動，受衝擊後間距與偏心改變，焦距與軸上彗差漂移；膠層在紫外光下黃化，藍端穿透率下降。~A cemented pair with a large expansion mismatch delaminates in the cold, showing Newton rings and silvery reflections at the edge as wavefront and transmission degrade together; a loose spacer in an air-spaced doublet lets gap and decentre change after shock so focal length and on-axis coma drift; cement yellows under UV and blue transmission falls.
units.misconception: 空氣間隔雙合只是沒上膠的膠合透鏡，光學性能完全相同。~An air-spaced doublet is just an uncemented cemented doublet with identical optics.

units.anchor: 定心磨邊與膠合治具~Centring, edging and cementing fixtures
units.title: 生產定心、磨邊與膠合工序~Production centring, edging and cementing
units.mechanism: 拋光完成的鏡片，其光軸（兩曲率中心的連線）通常不與外徑同軸。定心磨邊時把鏡片裝在主軸上，先讓光軸對準旋轉軸：曲率夠大的鏡片可用鐘形夾頭自動定心，曲率淺的彎月或弱負透鏡夾持角不足，必須以自準直儀觀察反射像隨旋轉的晃動做光學定心，再把外徑磨成與光軸同心，殘差以楔角或邊厚差表示。膠合時兩片在 10 到 20 µm 的膠層上相對移動，同時觀察各面反射像使它們同心，再以紫外或加熱固化；膠的固化收縮會拉動鏡片，所以固化後必須再量一次整組的定心。~A polished element's optical axis, the line through its two centres of curvature, generally does not coincide with its outer diameter. In centring and edging the element sits on a spindle and its optical axis is first aligned to the rotation axis: strongly curved elements self-centre in bell chucks, while shallow menisci and weak negative lenses lack clamping angle and must be centred optically by watching the reflected image wobble in an autocollimator; the edge is then ground concentric with the optical axis, and the residual is stated as wedge or edge-thickness variation. In cementing the two elements are slid on a 10 to 20 µm cement layer while the reflected images of all surfaces are made concentric, then cured by UV or heat; cure shrinkage pulls the elements, so the centring of the finished pair must be measured again after cure.
units.model: 半徑 R = 60 mm 的面偏心 c = 10 µm，傾斜 ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad（0.57′）；Ø25 mm 的邊厚差 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm；光束偏折 (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″，在 f = 100 mm 像面造成 8.6 µm 的視軸偏移，約 2.5 個 3.45 µm 像素。曲率中心自準直時，偏心 c 在主軸旋轉下表現為半徑 2c = 20 µm 的圓。~A surface of radius R = 60 mm decentred by c = 10 µm tilts by ε = c/R = 0.167 mrad (0.57′); over Ø25 mm the edge-thickness variation is 25 mm × 0.167 mrad = 4.2 µm; the beam deviates by (n − 1)ε = 0.517 × 0.167 mrad = 86 µrad = 17.8″, shifting the boresight by 8.6 µm at f = 100 mm, about 2.5 pixels of 3.45 µm. In centre-of-curvature autocollimation the decentre c appears as a circle of radius 2c = 20 µm as the spindle turns.
units.verify: 單片以迴轉台與千分錶量邊厚差，或以定心儀量各面曲率中心相對基準軸的偏移；膠合固化後用多面定心量測儀透過所有面量整組偏心，並以平行光管比較光學視軸與機械軸；把每片的偏心、邊厚差與固化前後差值記錄到序號。~Measure each element's edge-thickness variation with a rotary table and dial gauge, or the offset of each surface's centre of curvature from the datum axis with a centring instrument; after cure measure the pair's decentration through all surfaces with a multi-surface centring instrument and compare optical boresight with the mechanical axis using a collimator; log each element's decentre, edge variation and pre- and post-cure difference against its serial number.
units.failure: 膠層厚度不均使固化收縮不對稱，濕膠時對準良好的組件固化後出現楔角；膠中氣泡或灰塵成為散射點；磨邊崩角成為應力集中處，熱循環時裂紋由此擴展；邊厚差超規使軸上出現彗差，影像清晰度在視場兩側不對稱。~Uneven cement thickness makes cure shrinkage asymmetric, so a pair aligned perfectly while wet acquires a wedge after cure; bubbles or dust in the cement become scatter points; edge chips from edging concentrate stress and cracks grow from them during thermal cycling; out-of-spec edge variation puts coma on axis and makes sharpness asymmetric across the field.
units.misconception: 鏡片拋光到正確曲率後自然就是同心的，不需要另外定心。~A lens polished to the right radii is automatically centred.

units.anchor: 感測器像素與 MTF~Sensor pixels and MTF
units.title: 依感測器匹配設計與 MTF 判準~Sensor-matched design and MTF criteria
units.mechanism: 相機用的消色差透鏡要以感測器取樣來評判：像素間距 p 決定 Nyquist 頻率 ν_N = 1/(2p)，系統 MTF 等於鏡頭 MTF 乘像素孔徑的 sinc 響應；鏡頭在 f 數 N 的繞射截止頻率為 1/(λN)。殘餘的二級光譜就是隨波長變化的離焦，多色 MTF 要以感測器光譜響應加權；拜耳濾色片讓紅藍通道的取樣頻率再減半。因此規格應寫成在 Nyquist 或其一半、中心與邊緣的多色 MTF，並要求各色焦點散佈落在 ±2λN² 的像素尺度景深內。~An achromat for a camera must be judged against sensor sampling: pixel pitch p sets the Nyquist frequency ν_N = 1/(2p), and system MTF is lens MTF times the sinc response of the pixel aperture, with the lens's diffraction cutoff at 1/(λN) for f-number N. Residual secondary spectrum is a wavelength-dependent defocus, so polychromatic MTF must be weighted by the sensor's spectral response, and a Bayer filter halves the sampling rate again for the red and blue channels. The specification should therefore state polychromatic MTF at Nyquist or half Nyquist at centre and edge, and require the colour focus spread to fall within the pixel-scale depth of focus ±2λN².
units.model: p = 3.45 µm，ν_N = 145 lp/mm；f/4、0.55 µm 截止 455 lp/mm，繞射 MTF(145) ≈ 0.60，像素 sinc 0.64，未計像差已只剩 0.38。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 對焦在 d 線時，C、F 離焦 50 µm，W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) 分別為 0.60λ 與 0.80λ，Nyquist MTF 只剩 0.05 與 0.02；改用 N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 雙合，色焦差 14.2 µm，C、F 為 0.47 與 0.55。~p = 3.45 µm gives ν_N = 145 lp/mm; at f/4 and 0.55 µm the cutoff is 455 lp/mm, diffraction MTF(145) ≈ 0.60 and pixel sinc 0.64, already 0.38 before aberrations. An N-BK7/F2 doublet at f = 100 mm focused on the d line leaves C and F 50 µm out, W₀₂₀ = Δz/(8N²λ) of 0.60λ and 0.80λ, so their Nyquist MTF falls to 0.05 and 0.02; an N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 doublet has a 14.2 µm colour spread and gives 0.47 and 0.55.
units.verify: 以斜邊法在實際感測器上量 MTF，分別取紅、綠、藍通道，或在 MTF 量測台上配窄帶濾光片逐波長量；每個波長做穿焦掃描求最佳焦點位置，直接量出色焦差並與 50 µm 或 14.2 µm 的設計值比較；量測頻率至少涵蓋 Nyquist 與其一半，並在中心與 70% 視場各量一次。~Measure MTF on the actual sensor by the slanted-edge method for the red, green and blue channels separately, or on an MTF bench with narrow-band filters wavelength by wavelength; run a through-focus scan per wavelength to locate best focus, measuring the colour focus spread directly against the 50 µm or 14.2 µm design value; cover at least Nyquist and half Nyquist, at the centre and at 70% field.
units.failure: 以 N-BK7/F2 雙合搭配 3.45 µm 像素與 f/4，紅藍通道模糊，高對比邊緣出現紫邊；若規格只寫 546 nm 單色 MTF，鏡頭在檢驗台上全數合格，裝上相機後彩色影像卻不合格，責任在規格而非製造。~Pairing an N-BK7/F2 doublet with 3.45 µm pixels at f/4 blurs the red and blue channels and puts purple fringes on high-contrast edges; a specification written only as 546 nm monochromatic MTF lets every lens pass on the bench while colour images fail in the camera, a fault of the specification rather than manufacturing.
units.misconception: 只要鏡頭在綠光達到繞射極限，彩色影像就一定清晰。~If the lens is diffraction-limited in green, colour images will be sharp.

units.anchor: 雙程 Fizeau 穿透波前~Double-pass Fizeau transmitted wavefront
units.title: 干涉儀穿透波前量測與波長換算~Interferometric transmitted-wavefront test and wavelength conversion
units.mechanism: 穿透波前誤差通常用 632.8 nm 的 Fizeau 或 Twyman–Green 干涉儀量：平行測試光穿過鏡片聚焦到參考返回球，原路折返再穿過鏡片一次，所以量到的光程差是單程的兩倍。Zernike 擬合可把傾斜與離焦移除，剩下的像散、彗差與球差分別指向應力、定心與曲率或間距問題。但 HeNe 測試是單色的，看不到色差；它的焦點位置也與設計波長不同，球差還會隨波長改變（色球差），所以 632.8 nm 的合格判定必須依設計模型換算到使用波段。~Transmitted wavefront error is usually measured with a 632.8 nm Fizeau or Twyman–Green interferometer: the collimated test beam passes through the lens to focus on a reference return sphere and comes back through the lens, so the measured optical path difference is twice the single-pass value. A Zernike fit removes tilt and focus, and the remaining astigmatism, coma and spherical terms point to stress, centring and radius or spacing problems respectively. But a HeNe test is monochromatic and blind to colour; its focus differs from the design wavelength's, and spherical aberration varies with wavelength (spherochromatism), so a pass at 632.8 nm must be converted to the working band through the design model.
units.model: 雙程量得 0.10λ rms（632.8 nm），單程 0.05λ = 31.6 nm；換到 546 nm 為 0.058λ，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876；Maréchal 0.8 要求在 546 nm ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm。N-BK7/F2、f = 100 mm 雙合在 632.8 nm 的焦點位於 d 焦點後 28.8 µm，返回球須放在此處，這個焦點偏移本身也能核對玻璃組合是否正確。~A double-pass reading of 0.10λ rms at 632.8 nm is 0.05λ = 31.6 nm single pass, or 0.058λ at 546 nm, giving Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 0.058)²] ≈ 0.876; a Maréchal 0.8 requires ≤ λ/14 = 39 nm at 546 nm. The 632.8 nm focus of an N-BK7/F2 f = 100 mm doublet lies 28.8 µm behind the d focus, so the return sphere must sit there, and that offset itself checks that the glass pair is right.
units.verify: 先以旋轉或隨機球平均法校正返回球與參考面的誤差；鏡片在夾具中量 0° 與 180° 兩個方位，相減分離鏡片與系統誤差；把 Zernike 彗差與定心量測結果交叉比對；記錄多次量測的平均與標準差，並把量得的 632.8 nm 焦點位置與模型的 28.8 µm 預測比較。~Calibrate the return sphere and reference surface first by rotation or random-ball averaging; measure the lens at 0° and 180° in its fixture and difference the results to separate lens from system error; cross-check Zernike coma with centring measurements; log the mean and standard deviation of repeated measurements, and compare the measured 632.8 nm focus position with the modelled 28.8 µm offset.
units.failure: 忘記把雙程結果除以 2 或沒扣除參考面誤差，合格鏡片被誤判報廢；鏡片在 632.8 nm 合格卻在 486 nm 因色球差不合格；測試夾具夾得太緊，量到的像散其實是夾持應力，卻被歸咎於拋光。~Forgetting to halve the double-pass result or to subtract reference error scraps good lenses; a lens passes at 632.8 nm but fails at 486 nm through spherochromatism; an over-tight test fixture produces astigmatism that is really clamping stress yet is blamed on polishing.
units.misconception: HeNe 干涉儀量到的波前合格，就代表整個可見光波段都合格。~A wavefront pass at 632.8 nm means the lens passes across the visible band.

units.anchor: 鬼影路徑與邊緣雜散光~Ghost paths and edge stray light
units.title: 雜散光與鬼影分析~Stray-light and ghost analysis
units.mechanism: 每個折射面都會反射一點光，經過兩次反射的光又朝感測器前進，形成亮光源的離焦複本，即鬼影。N 個面之間的二次反射路徑共有 N(N − 1)/2 條；膠合雙合有 3 個面，空氣間隔版有 4 個，再加上感測器保護玻璃與感測器本身，而感測器往往是最強的反射面。鬼影照度取決於兩面反射率與鬼影在感測器上的離焦程度，聚焦在感測器附近的鬼影最危險。另一類雜散光來自研磨鏡緣散射、鏡筒內壁與螺紋，以及膠中的氣泡。分析時先用近軸鬼影追跡找出鬼影焦點，再以非序列光線追跡估算照度。~Every refracting surface reflects a little light, and light reflected twice heads back toward the sensor as an out-of-focus copy of a bright source, a ghost. Among N surfaces there are N(N − 1)/2 two-bounce paths; a cemented doublet has 3 surfaces and an air-spaced one 4, plus the sensor cover glass and the sensor itself, which is often the strongest reflector. Ghost irradiance depends on the two reflectances and how defocused the ghost is at the sensor, and a ghost that focuses near the sensor is the most dangerous. Other stray light comes from scatter off ground lens edges, barrel walls and threads, and bubbles in the cement. Analysis starts with paraxial ghost tracing to locate ghost foci and then estimates irradiance by non-sequential ray tracing.
units.model: 路徑數：膠合 3 面有 3 條、空氣間隔 4 面有 6 條；雙合加 2 面保護玻璃與感測器共 6 面，15 條。感測器（R = 4%）與鏡頭後表面（鍍膜 R = 0.5%）之間的鬼影能量比 2×10⁻⁴；若 50 µm 的 LED 像變成 0.5 mm 的鬼影圓盤，峰值比 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶；LED 超出滿井 1000 倍時，鬼影達滿井的 0.2%，在 12 位元感測器約 8 LSB，肉眼可見。~Paths: 3 for a cemented 3-surface doublet and 6 for an air-spaced 4-surface one; a doublet plus a 2-surface cover glass and the sensor makes 6 surfaces and 15 paths. A ghost between the sensor (R = 4%) and the rear lens surface (coated R = 0.5%) carries an energy ratio of 2×10⁻⁴; if a 50 µm LED image becomes a 0.5 mm ghost disc the peak ratio is 2×10⁻⁴ × (50/500)² = 2×10⁻⁶, and with the LED 1000 times over full well the ghost reaches 0.2% of full well, about 8 LSB on a 12-bit sensor and visible.
units.verify: 以準直的強光源在多個視場角掃描，用長曝光或高動態範圍拍攝鏡頭加感測器的影像，標出鬼影位置與大小並與鬼影追跡比較；以積分球加黑點的方法量面眩光指數；檢查鏡緣是否塗黑、鏡筒內壁是否有消光螺紋，並在紅外波段重複測試，確認鍍膜在感測器全響應範圍內都有效。~Scan a bright collimated source across several field angles and record lens plus sensor with long exposures or high dynamic range, mark ghost positions and sizes and compare with the ghost trace; measure the veiling-glare index with an integrating sphere and black spot; check that lens edges are blackened and barrel walls carry baffling threads, and repeat in the near infrared to confirm the coating works across the sensor's full response.
units.failure: 未塗黑的研磨鏡緣把視場外的強光散射成整片霧光，對比下降；抗反射膜只針對可見光最佳化，感測器在近紅外仍有響應，夜間模式鬼影突然明顯；聚焦在感測器上的鬼影成為與光源反向移動的亮點，被誤判為缺陷像素或目標。~An unblackened ground edge scatters a bright out-of-field source into a veil of haze that lowers contrast; a coating optimised only for the visible leaves high near-infrared reflectance where the sensor still responds, so ghosts suddenly appear in night mode; a ghost focused on the sensor becomes a bright spot moving opposite to the source, mistaken for a defective pixel or a target.
units.misconception: 只要鍍了抗反射膜，就不會出現鬼影。~Once an antireflection coating is applied, ghosts cannot appear.

units.anchor: 驗收矩陣與保護帶~Acceptance matrix and guard band
units.title: 量產驗收矩陣、保護帶與交接~Production acceptance matrix, guard bands and handoff
units.mechanism: 量產驗收把設計轉成可量的門檻：有效焦距與後焦、指定頻率與視場的多色 MTF、軸向色焦差、632.8 nm 穿透波前、定心與視軸、鬼影檢查、熱離焦，以及依 ISO 10110-7 標示的表面瑕疵。量測不確定度必須遠小於公差，測試不確定度比至少 4；下限規格的允收門檻要加上保護帶，即門檻 = 規格 + U，在生產者風險（誤拒好件）與使用者風險（誤收壞件）之間取捨。量測台本身要做重複性與再現性研究，並以標準鏡每日校驗。~Production acceptance turns the design into measurable gates: effective and back focal length, polychromatic MTF at specified frequencies and fields, axial colour focus spread, 632.8 nm transmitted wavefront, centring and boresight, ghost checks, thermal defocus and surface imperfections stated per ISO 10110-7. Measurement uncertainty must be well below tolerance, with a test uncertainty ratio of at least 4; for a lower-limit specification the acceptance threshold is guard-banded as threshold = spec + U, trading producer risk of rejecting good parts against consumer risk of accepting bad ones. The test bench itself needs a repeatability and reproducibility study and a daily check against a reference lens.
units.model: 規格：72 lp/mm 多色 MTF ≥ 0.30；量測擴充不確定度 U = 0.03（k = 2），保護帶門檻 0.33。若量產平均 0.38、標準差 0.025，有保護帶的良率 Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%，不加保護帶為 Φ(3.2) = 99.93%，但會放行真值略低於 0.30 的鏡頭。焦距公差 ±0.5 mm、U = 0.1 mm，測試不確定度比 5，符合 ≥ 4 的要求。~Specification: polychromatic MTF ≥ 0.30 at 72 lp/mm with expanded uncertainty U = 0.03 (k = 2), so the guard-banded threshold is 0.33. With a production mean of 0.38 and standard deviation 0.025, guard-banded yield is Φ((0.38 − 0.33)/0.025) = Φ(2.0) = 97.7%, against Φ(3.2) = 99.93% without a guard band, which would release lenses whose true MTF lies just below 0.30. A focal-length tolerance of ±0.5 mm with U = 0.1 mm gives a test uncertainty ratio of 5, meeting the ≥ 4 requirement.
units.verify: 對 MTF 量測台做量測系統分析：10 顆鏡頭 × 3 位操作員 × 3 次重複，計算重複性與再現性佔公差的百分比；每日以標準鏡確認讀值在管制界限內；與客戶的量測台做相關性比對，找出系統偏差；把每顆鏡頭的量測值、玻璃熔次、膠批號與設計模型版本一併記錄到序號。~Run a measurement-system analysis on the MTF bench with 10 lenses × 3 operators × 3 repeats and compute repeatability and reproducibility as a percentage of tolerance; check daily that the reference lens reads within control limits; correlate with the customer's bench to find systematic bias; record each lens's results with glass melt lot, cement batch and design-model version under its serial number.
units.failure: 供應商與客戶的 MTF 量測台相差 0.04，整批在進料檢驗被退回；未設保護帶，邊緣件流入產品造成客訴；標準鏡在搬運中受損而讀值偏高，未被察覺下所有鏡頭都被高估。~Supplier and customer MTF benches differ by 0.04 and whole lots are rejected at incoming inspection; without a guard band marginal parts reach products and return as complaints; a reference lens damaged in handling reads high unnoticed, so every lens is overestimated.
units.misconception: 量到的 MTF 只要比規格高一點點，就一定可以放行。~A lens whose measured MTF is just above spec can always be released.

example: 焦點預算練習：f = 100 mm、f/4 的 N-BK7/F2 膠合雙合，f₁ = 43.3 mm、f₂ = −76.4 mm，搭配 3.45 µm 像素（Nyquist 145 lp/mm）。二級光譜使 C、F 焦點在 d 後 50 µm；把感測器放在中間 +25 µm，d、C、F 各離焦 25 µm，W₀₂₀ 為 0.33λ、0.30λ、0.40λ，Nyquist MTF 約 0.36、0.35、0.37，乘像素 sinc 0.64 後約 0.23。溫度上升 40 K：鏡片焦距伸長 100 × 1.53×10⁻⁶ × 40 = 6.1 µm，鋁鏡筒伸長 94.4 µm，失配 88 µm 遠超 ±17.6 µm 景深；改用 Invar 隔圈後殘差 1.3 µm。若改用 N-FK51A/N-KZFS4（f₁ = 47.3 mm、f₂ = −89.8 mm），色焦差降為 14.2 µm，置中後各色離焦 7.1 µm，Nyquist MTF 約 0.51 到 0.62，乘像素響應後約 0.33 到 0.39，足以通過 0.30 的規格。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品規格。~Focus-budget exercise: an f = 100 mm, f/4 cemented N-BK7/F2 doublet with f₁ = 43.3 mm and f₂ = −76.4 mm on 3.45 µm pixels (Nyquist 145 lp/mm). Secondary spectrum puts the C and F foci 50 µm behind d; placing the sensor midway at +25 µm defocuses d, C and F by 25 µm each, W₀₂₀ of 0.33λ, 0.30λ and 0.40λ, giving Nyquist MTF near 0.36, 0.35 and 0.37, about 0.23 after the 0.64 pixel sinc. A 40 K rise lengthens the lens focal length by 100 × 1.53×10⁻⁶ × 40 = 6.1 µm while an aluminium barrel grows 94.4 µm, an 88 µm mismatch far beyond the ±17.6 µm depth of focus; an Invar spacer leaves 1.3 µm. Switching to N-FK51A/N-KZFS4 (f₁ = 47.3 mm, f₂ = −89.8 mm) cuts the colour spread to 14.2 µm, so centred focus leaves each colour 7.1 µm out, Nyquist MTF about 0.51 to 0.62 and roughly 0.33 to 0.39 with the pixel response, enough to pass a 0.30 specification. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 1733 年前後 Chester Moor Hall 以冠牌與火石玻璃做出消色差透鏡，1758 年 John Dollond 取得專利並推廣到望遠鏡。十九世紀 Fraunhofer 以太陽譜線精確量測色散，1880 年代 Ernst Abbe 與 Otto Schott 在耶拿開發部分色散偏離正常線的新玻璃，使複消色差物鏡得以實現。今日玻璃廠以 Sellmeier 係數與 dn/dT 常數公開資料，讓設計者同時處理色差與熱離焦。本課只重建公開光學原理與工程邏輯。~Around 1733 Chester Moor Hall made an achromatic lens from crown and flint glass, and in 1758 John Dollond patented it and spread it to telescopes. In the nineteenth century Fraunhofer measured dispersion precisely with solar lines, and in the 1880s Ernst Abbe and Otto Schott in Jena developed new glasses whose partial dispersion departs from the normal line, making apochromatic objectives possible. Glassmakers now publish Sellmeier coefficients and dn/dT constants so designers can handle colour and thermal defocus together. This course reconstructs only public optical principles and engineering logic.

感測器與 MTF 取樣
